label: Finding-32
title: scale-70pc-websites: Cloudflare does cite its survey: the 70_ links to W3Techs
description: The claim note says 'None of the three cites the survey it comes from', numbers.json n-70-websites says 'Neither page names the survey', and a sections.json page says 'None of the pages that use it says how' it was measured. Cloudflare's rendered.html (capture 20261022T081216Z) hyperlinks '70% of websites' to https://w3techs.com/technologies/details/pl-php. The text.txt drops the link, which is likely why it was missed. OpenAI and Wiz do not cite a source.
